overall_comment: Predictions are based only on the supplied MRI metadata without diffusion, perfusion, spectroscopy, or susceptibility information. The IDH and 1p/19q calls are only moderately confident because young age and large nonenhancing cortical tumor burden support IDH-mutant disease, while necrosis, enhancement, ependymal invasion, deep white-matter invasion, and mass effect support aggressive high-grade biology. Tissue molecular testing remains required for definitive WHO CNS5 classification.
